import sys
from collections import Counter

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()

        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    counts = Counter(arr)
    for num, cnt in counts.items():
        if cnt == 1:
            print(num)
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

    for num, cnt in counts.items():
        if cnt == 1:
            print(num)
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
